headline: Kenya's Equity Group Nine-Month Profit Jumps 32% to Sh71.5 Billion
summary: Equity Group Holdings recorded a 32% increase in nine-month profit after tax to 71.5 billion Kenyan shillings, driven by solid expansion in net interest income across its regional banking footprint.
why: Equity Group is Kenya's largest financial institution by customer numbers, operating subsidiaries across Kenya, DRC, Uganda, Rwanda, South Sudan, and Tanzania.

impacts.name: Equity Group Holdings
impacts.why: A 32% expansion in nine-month earnings strengthens capital buffers and dividend prospects.
